mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) reduces the cost of capital and increases the present value of future corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase marked by high housing starts (HOUST > 1600 thousand units) and a CPIAUCSL index above 260 (indicating elevated inflation), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to policy tightening fears and profit-taking, leading to negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1600 and CPIAUCSL > 260, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 thousand units indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 260 (index) and decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.5% signals a central bank's response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as the market prices in a potential rate cut that may not be enough.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient with p-value < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as the central bank eases policy and the economy recovers, leading to positive returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
